t2.thesis: CORZ enters the print in a sector-wide AI-landlord/debt selloff with a weak earnings-reaction record, heavy put volume and high short interest, which tilts slightly below the base rate despite a large positive-skew rebound possibility.
reasons: Last 4 prints: only 1 of 4 rose at the open (win rate 0.25), including a drop after the last beat
Sector is under pressure: KBW cut targets on 7 miners/AI hosts, CIFR and WULF fell, neocloud debt worries (I9, I10, I20)
Put/call volume is ~4.9 and puts are priced richer than calls (call IV minus put IV about -0.11), a modestly bearish options tilt
Stock is down 36% over 12 months and 53% below its 52-week high, with 27% short interest, so a squeeze bounce is possible
Implied move of about 12% is large, so the outcome is close to a coin flip with fat tails
t2.deciding_variable: Whether new lease announcements, financing and capex funding commentary reassure investors about the debt-funded buildout, versus renewed concerns about CoreWeave concentration and dilution.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit 0.542, BMO 0.548; crypto_proxy cluster (n=8) is insufficient, so not used

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-03, so the 2026-11-05 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how CORZ (Core Scientific) stock moved afterward.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 7 points from 0.54 to 0.47: weak earnings-reaction history, sector de-rating and bearish put flow, partly offset by the high short interest and the strong AMD/contracted-revenue backdrop.

theses.mechanism: Strong colocation ramp (billing MW above 437), AMD lease progress and released restricted cash trigger a short squeeze from depressed levels
theses.wrong_if: Guidance on billing MW or capex funding disappoints, or new financing is dilutive

theses.mechanism: Sector-wide AI-landlord de-rating and funding worries make any delay or cost overrun get punished, as in the last three prints
theses.wrong_if: Management announces new tenants or non-dilutive financing that eases credit concerns

theses.mechanism: Much of the AMD and financing news is already priced in, so the open lands near entry and sector beta decides the direction
theses.wrong_if: A large surprise in revenue or contract news pushes the stock beyond about 10%

key_observations: Billing MW versus the 437 MW mid-July figure and the timing of the remaining 195 MW
Capex funding plan, debt costs, and any equity or warrant dilution
New tenant diversification beyond CoreWeave and the AMD/Neocloud lease ramp
ERCOT Batch Zero commentary on Pecos and Hunt
Pre-market sector tone (CIFR, WULF, IREN) on Nov 4-5
